svg.desc: Code, data, environment and randomness must all be pinned for a result to reproduce; the decisions behind it are written down next to the result.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four pins make a number reproducible

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plus a fifth that no tool can pin for you.

svg.text: The same number, on another machine, months later

svg.text: Miss one pin and you will eventually get a different number with no idea why. A seed makes a run repeatable, not reliable.
